AAR.caption: date/time is selected
AAR.doc: Triggered whenever a date or time is selected.
AAR.name: dateready

AAD.caption: Picker type
AAD.doc: Defines which kind of picker is displayed: "date", "time" or "datetime-local".
AAD.name: format

AAG.caption: Minute step interval
AAG.doc: Sets the minute interval used for time selection (e.g., 5 = 00, 05, 10...).
AAG.name: step

AAH.caption: Minimum date/time
AAH.doc: Sets the minimum selectable date/time. (Reserved for future logic implementation.)
AAH.name: min

AAI.caption: Maximum date/time
AAI.doc: Sets the maximum selectable date/time. (Reserved for future logic implementation.)
AAI.name: max

AAJ.caption: Initial date/time
AAJ.doc: Sets an initial date/time value displayed when the element loads.
AAJ.name: initial

AAK.caption: Color scheme
AAK.doc: Defines the color style of the picker. Options: "light", "dark", "normal", or "customized".
AAK.name: colorscheme

AAL.caption: Center content vertically
AAL.doc: Centers the input horizontally and vertically inside the element using flexbox.
AAL.name: vcenter

AAN.caption: Fit width to content
AAN.doc: If true, the element width automatically adapts to the content. Otherwise, it fills 100% of the container width.
AAN.name: fitwidth

AAO.caption: Fit height to content
AAO.doc: If true, the element height adjusts automatically to its content.
AAO.name: fitheight

AAZ.caption: Border color
AAZ.doc: Defines the border color for the popup (used only when colorscheme = "customized")
AAZ.name: bordercolor

AAa.caption: Border radius (px)
AAa.doc: Rounds the corners of the popup and selectable elements. (only used in "customized" mode)
AAa.name: borderradius

AAb.caption: Border width (px)
AAb.doc: Sets the thickness of the popup border.(only used in "customized" mode)
AAb.name: borderwidth

AAc.caption: Background color
AAc.doc: Defines the background color of the popup (only used in "customized" mode)
AAc.name: backgroundcolor

AAd.caption: Font color
AAd.doc: Sets the text color used inside the popup. (only used in "customized" mode)
AAd.name: fontcolor

AAe.caption: Font size (px)
AAe.doc: Sets the font size for the popup content. (only used in "customized" mode)
AAe.name: fontsize

AAf.caption: Selected item color
AAf.doc: Sets the highlight color for the selected item in the calendar or time selector. (only used in "customized" mode)
AAf.name: selectedcolor

AAg.caption: Hover color
AAg.doc: Sets the hover color when the user moves the mouse over a selectable item. (only used in "customized" mode)
AAg.name: hovercolor

AAh.caption: Selection padding (px)
AAh.doc: Internal padding for each selectable item (day, month, hour, minute). (only used in "customized" mode)
AAh.name: selectionpadding

AAi.caption: Custom icon URL
AAi.doc: Optional. Defines the image URL to use as a custom icon. If empty, the default calendar emoji (📅) will be shown.
AAi.name: iconurl

AAj.caption: Icon size (px)
AAj.doc: Defines the size (width and height) of the icon on the right side of the input.
AAj.name: iconsize

AAk.caption: Popup direction (up/down)
AAk.doc: Defines whether the popup opens upward or downward relative to the input element.
AAk.name: popup_direction

AAl.caption: Input width (px)
AAl.doc: Defines a fixed input width in pixels. If empty, it defaults to 100%.
AAl.name: input_width

AAm.caption: Input height (px)
AAm.doc: Defines a fixed input height in pixels. If empty, it defaults to 100%.
AAm.name: input_height

AAn.caption: Input padding (px)
AAn.doc: Controls the inner spacing of the input. Helps visually center the text.
AAn.name: input_padding

AAq.caption: Popup padding (px)
AAq.doc: Defines the global inner spacing of the popup (fallback for selectionpadding). (used only when colorscheme = "customized")
AAq.name: popuppadding

AAE.caption: date
AAE.doc: Returns the selected date/time as a date object.
AAE.name: date

AAF.caption: date_string
AAF.doc: Returns the selected date/time as a formatted text string.
AAF.name: date_string
